Above 2X, every generated frame can land at the midpoint between two real frames, so 3X/4X
shows more frames but no smoother motion. This gives each its own time.
Auto / Reuse Blackwell kernel: uses the Blackwell interpolation kernel the DLSSG module
already carries. This is the default.
Rewrite blend weight: edits the Ada kernel's PTX instead. It only works on DLSSG builds
it recognises. Try it only if 3X/4X motion is not smoother.
ini: [DLSSG] AdaTemporalFix. Save Settings and restart to apply.

Asking for more than one generated frame while hardware flip metering is on can freeze the picture.
This edits NVIDIA's Streamline DLSS-G plugin in memory, when it loads, so that it paces in
software instead. It refuses unless the plugin's code is of the shape it recognises.
Use it only if 3X or more freezes. [NvApi] DisableFlipMetering=true (ini only) is milder; try
that first.
ini: [DLSSG] AdaFlipMeteringPatch. Save Settings and restart to apply.
